queries: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM `workspace`.`information_schema`.`columns` WHERE table_schema = 'default' AND table_name = 'bank_loan' ORDER BY ordinal_position

WITH base AS (SELECT `job` AS _k0, `id` AS _order, `education` AS _value FROM `workspace`.`default`.`bank_loan`),
quality AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN _k0 IS NULL OR _order IS NULL OR _value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing FROM base),
ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY _k0 ORDER BY _order DESC) AS _rank FROM base),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE _rank = 1),
key_counts AS (SELECT _k0, COUNT(*) AS n FROM latest GROUP BY _k0),
frequencies AS (SELECT CAST(_value AS STRING) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM latest GROUP BY _value)
SELECT 0 AS __kind, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS __value, 0 AS __frequency,
n AS __input_rows, missing AS __null_rows,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM key_counts WHERE n > 1) AS __tied_keys,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM key_counts) AS __selected_keys,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frequencies) AS __categories FROM quality
UNION ALL
SELECT 1, v, n, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM frequencies
ORDER BY __kind, __value LIMIT 52

SELECT CAST(`education` AS STRING) AS category, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM (SELECT `education`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY `job` ORDER BY `id` DESC) AS rn FROM `workspace`.`default`.`bank_loan`) chosen WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY `education` ORDER BY category
